newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ono Pharm to start UK clinical test on tumour drug.
newsitem.headline: Ono Pharm to start UK clinical test on tumour drug.

text.p: Ono Pharmaceuticals Co Ltd said on Friday that it would start clinical trials on a tumour-fighting drug in Britain in mid-November.
The drug is currently going through the second phase of three-stage clinical trials in Japan, a company spokesman said.
In the course of development, the drug, ONO-4007, has been found to be effective in the treatment of skin cancer by boosting the body's ability to fight the tumour cells, the spokesman said.
The company also plans to start clinical testing of the drug in the United States after seeing the results of the trials in Japan and Europe, it said in a statement.
